notes.title: AE2 Developmental Update #2 - Dropship, Drones and Troops!
notes.notes:
[h1][i][b]Greetings![/b][/i][/h1]

Development has been going very well, we are working on more complicated features that take more time to code. One of them will be featured today! Thanks to all the valuable feedback the community has given us, it's been very beneficial towards the development process. 

[h2][b]Dropship, Drones and Troops[/b][/h2]

The Dropship concept gives the Mechs the ability to call in re-inforcements upon engagement. The way it works is that the Mech can signal for support, drop a smoke grenade to mark a landing spot and a Dropship will fly in and deliver up to 8 Ground Troops at a time. Currently there is only one mech that can do this, the Scout Mech, but depending on how testing will go, this can definitely change!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/64a64923f493e166de908e2afa6d50995649ab35.jpg[/img]

Currently, there are 3 different types of Ground Troops, each with their own behavior. The Sniper will engage at a farther distance and behave more cautiously. The Machine Gunner will engage at a medium distance and not advance too close. The Assault soldier will behave most agressively and advance with a sacrificial behavior. These troops may distract your Turrets from the more valuable Mechs in a strategic move to overwhelm your defenses. While individually these won't prove too much of a threat, in groups they can be devastating if unchallenged!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/6d1bb341781a7eb7d9247c617fcac41f2a094c87.jpg[/img]

There are three enemy drone classes each with their own weapon system and threat level. First you will encounter the lower level drones, but as time goes on expect to suffer the more powerful drones!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/7af253e62fd0df3f3e2676bb227d208672d13aa7.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/1b6c47592c0b87f74ffbdabca24d20cc0a05bbb3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/ab127287b2c2cb02d4775afee85477b3082e9fc5.jpg[/img]

All these enemies! Time to start working on the vast arsenal you will have to combat this army of enemy AI. This 'Emergency Drone' is on your side. Feel like your being overrun? Need some backup? This emergency drone is extremely powerful and devastating, but it's also got it's disadvantages such as long reload time as well needing lots of Tech upgrades to perform it's best!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/755f993485482350b5f5349ffe97c48d0ac8720e.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2]

Turrets, turrets and more turrets. With such a vast array of enemy classes, you will need just as equal a variety of weaponry to defend against their attacks. Initially quite basic, there will be many upgradable features on each Turret to transform them into efficient machines of destruction. There are currently plans for up to 8 different turrets all with differing roles on the battlefield. Keep in mine, it's still early in development and anything can change!

If you would like early sneak peaks at what we work on before the monthly post, join our discord to see them!

Thanks again for all of your support and suggestions!

Discord link: https://discord.gg/p62Afqr

[h3][i][b]Until Next Time![/b][/i][/h3]

notes.title: AE2 Developmental Update #1 - Mechs and Armour System!
notes.notes:
[h1][i][b]Greetings![/b][/i][/h1]

It's been quite a while since our last update post announcing the sequel, so we would just like to update all of you on the new content we have worked on!

I'm sure from the title, you know what the topic is about, so let's get into it straightaway!

[h2][b]Mechs and Drones[/b][/h2]

Over the last month we have worked extensively on developing different types of Mechs that have different roles in the battlefield.  While we have shown the Mechs on discord, we would like to also share them here for your opinions :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/88cfc1f116dd16e3397a68e1acea3a2255c8eb7c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/4fb85edaefdf93711a505cecf85cf47fa218768a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/7ff5d15cabd2557c34feb930ccabea75e7f33bcb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/1736b54359802c40db9bc543e5ecc55450bb389a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/011f53cb25ad15462a3fc2f7af5ae9e2b90937fb.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/80b16cffecfbde02d5e33b230e68c5b37f5bbb82.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/947112515150dc62a57321bb32ff205a97e124cc.jpg[/img]

We have designated all of the Mechs into different levels based on their difficulty. At the moment, there are 4 levels. As the levels go up, the difficulty and sophistication of enemies increase. The Scouts are the basic enemy you encounter at the start of a game, so it'll be the easiest to deal with! But towards the end of the game, you'll meet enemies like the well rounded Battle Mech, which are universally strong and have a wide array of weaponry. So far, it is the most dangerous of the mechs as of yet. However, while it is well rounded, it doesn't excel at specific tasks like breaking shields like the Laser Mech can.

The new drones are functional but their weaponry has not yet been added. We will talk more about Drones on a later date once they are more developed. 

[h2][b]Armour and Shields[/b][/h2]

As described on the Mech Spec Sheets, their defenses are broken down into categories Shields, Armour and Health.  Turrets and enemies will both have this system. As of right now, shields take more damage from energy weapons. Armour absorbs more heavy damage and non-energy weapons and health is the primary health bar on which everything survives. As of right now, all of this is still in development and can change at any point!

[h2][b]What's Next?[/b][/h2]

Hard at work developing individual Mech abilities! For example, the Scout Mech can now expel a smoke 
 grenade that acts as a beacon to bring in reinforcement ground troops. We aim to create abilities like this for all of the Mechs, to make each one unique and a completely different challenge from the other!

A question we have asked on discord was what we should name the sequel. Should we stick with Artificial Extinction 2? Or perhaps Artificial Extinction: Retribution or Artificial Extinction: Retaliation? We would love to know your opinion on this topic!

And finally, we aim to make a post once a month detailing over what we have worked on so far so that you can keep up to date :) of course, if you would like early sneak peaks at what we work on before the monthly post, join our discord to see them!

Discord link: https://discord.gg/p62Afqr

[h3][i][b]Until Next Time![/b][/i][/h3]

notes.title: Our Next Project: Artificial Extinction 2
notes.notes:
[h1][i][b]Greetings![/b][/i][/h1]

It has been months of silence since our last update post, but we would like to announce that we have begun development of Artificial Extinction 2!

As stated in some other community posts, a full rewrite of the original game would be necessary to bring the game to it's fullest potential. The sequel will keep the best features of the original game but will add many crucial elements and depth. We listened to your feedback!

A few of the improvements will include a much broader array of Mech based enemies, both in appearance and skills. For instance, you might encounter a Railgun Mech, Gatling Mech or a Tesla Mech to name a few. They are smarter and will operate on their own logic system, each having their own strengths and weaknesses.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/748f4e866106432ab547adb9069cd981d2461613.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/9845ad8faaa3c16d7e570c5218d3a6ced7eba14e.jpg[/img]

Along with a more comprehensive variety of turrets and enemies, we also want to further the strategic aspects and depth of the game. With a comprehensive Tech Tree, you will have many decisions to make to play the game however you choose. Do you want to hunker down and defend? Aggressively occupy larger terrain and expand instead? 

Of course, we are still very early in development. We will talk more on other aspects of this game, such as terrain generation, and the more sophisticated and expanded features in the coming update posts.

We hope you will choose to support us, and join the discord community for further mini-updates on development progress. We are also aiming for monthly posts on everything we have worked until that point, so stay tuned for that!

Discord: https://discord.gg/p62Afqr

[i][b]Until next time![/b][/i]

notes.title: New Advanced Level Releasing April 30th!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Greetings![/b][/h1]

We are really excited to release first Advanced Level April 30th! This new level is one of our first steps in the Roadmap and we really hope you have fun with it. Here is a trailer for the new Advanced Level (full of spoilers, watch at your own risk):

[previewyoutube=Qvivo9qTZO8;full][/previewyoutube]

This level is different compared to the first 9 days because of the 1 hour play time with an auto save  triggered at 50% Fuel. So you can resume the game from midway through the level in case you make a mistake in the second half. This level is also substantially harder than other levels you've faced before. You will be encountering more sophisticated enemies and new environmental events. 

This level will also present to you the first version of the Tech Tree! Note that while this is not the final version of the Tech Tree, we are eagerly waiting community feedback. If you think a more advanced Tech Tree would add to the fun, this can be fully fleshed out! Currently, you operate the Tech Tree by collecting tech points from destroyed enemies, they will blink blue on the mini-map to show you where they are. Use 10 points to unlock the advanced Sentry's such as the Flak or Mortar Sentry! You can also unlock Nukes which can be aimed and dropped from the ship! Careful with those... :)

Please note this level is only unlocked after completing the first 9 days. 

Thanks very much to everyone’s kind words and support in the reviews and forums. A positive review really encourages us to work hard and keep going! Please do make sure to post some ideas of weapons and new features you want to be added into the next level or the Tech Tree down in the comments! 

Thanks again for supporting an Indie Dev!

notes.title: Roadmap Released – An Insight into Advanced Levels!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Greetings!
[/b][/h1]
We are proud to present you our Roadmap for our future plans for Artificial Extinction! There are a lot of exciting things coming to the game, namely the Advanced Levels unlocked after beating the 9 days.

Before we talk about the upcoming Advanced Levels, here is the Roadmap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/23ba9f1bf83d1f297e5c88647e6d3f12bf1c2ad7.jpg[/img]

We're hard at work on the first Advanced Level. It's adding new systems and components which takes time to create but rest assured that it will be released as soon as it's ready. As a rough guide, we're expecting to release the first Advanced Level in the 2 week range.

We hope you are as excited as we are about the future of Artificial Extinction! 

[b]Now let’s talk about the Advanced Levels.[/b]

The Advanced Levels are only unlocked for players who have finished the 9 days. Therefore, the levels will be a lot more challenging which we are sure you will enjoy! The levels will be longer, introduce special events such as darkness or weather, new sentry types, new terrain challenges, new enemy classes and enemy abilities to keep you on your toes.

Each level will be 1 hour long with an automatic trigger for level saving at 50% fuel. So if you die at 51% fuel, you will have the option to restart the level from the beginning or resume playing from 50% fuel. 

We are planning on releasing the first Advanced Level as Roadmap update 1. We love your feedback and once you've beaten Advanced Level 1 let us know what you think in the Discussion Forum! That will help us with planning the next Advanced Levels. 

[b]Thank you to everyone for your support and kind words, we can’t wait to make this game even better! [/b] If you're enjoying the game, nothing motivates us more than to see a positive review. Thank you to everyone who contributes with their ideas, bug reports and suggestions!

notes.title: New Sentry Revealed - For Advanced Level Use Only
notes.notes:
[b]I really liked your suggestions about some kind of longer range artillery/mortar sentry and I'm really excited to share it with you![/b]

In fact, a video was *accidentally* leaked on to the games YouTube channel that you can watch here:
[previewyoutube=3r_GIyC83vw;full][/previewyoutube]

The Mortar Sentry does not require line of sight to find it's target. It estimates the necessary trajectory to launch it's mortars and then releases the 6 projectiles. It adjusts it's aim between salvos trying to improve it's accuracy.

Each projectile contains a High Explosive that's deadly to armored targets within 5 meters and inflicts damage up to 20 meters. 

The Sentry is upgrade-able 2 levels just like the other Sentry classes. The details of each upgrade are still Top Secret but it may include improved accuracy, faster reloading times and a higher rate of fire. 

Ideally used against slow moving ground targets at 600m. 

These Mortar Sentries will be accessible in the upcoming Advanced Levels currently under development. 

[b]Future Plans - Advanced Levels[/b]
I'll do a more thorough post on the upcoming Advanced Levels currently under development but I just wanted to let you know that I'm hard at work on them. I want to make them the best levels yet with new challenges, more depth and more difficulty. You will have to complete the 9 Day campaign to have access to these Advanced Levels. 

[b]Shield System Implemented[/b]
A shield system has been implemented on the Prototype Max Test Level. It greatly reduces the amount of damage received from those stray rounds. One round disables the shield for 30 seconds though so don't rely on it too much. The shield system will also be implemented on the Advanced Levels. 

Stay tuned!

If you're enjoying the game and you feel the game is worth a positive review, that's a great way you can support me to keep adding to the game and it's really appreciated!

notes.title: Welcome To The AA Gun Show!
notes.notes:
[b]I love watching these AA Guns work. [/b]

The targeting system is [b]extremely complex[/b]. From recognizing the incoming threat, prioritizing the target, calculating it's trajectory and velocity, using it's own AA Rounds velocity to calculate how far ahead it should aim and then firing the burst, adjusting aim every... single... round. Build 6 of them to work cooperatively with each other to create quite an effective AA shield. 

[b]A successful hit actually requires the AA Round to impact the target.[/b] No 'slight of hand' programming hocus pocus, the round actually has to impact the target. No easy feat for even today's most advanced C-RAM systems. As the game developer, and a proud nerd, watching these things work so quickly and accurately is quite jaw dropping, better than I ever could have expected.

Impossible for a human to make these shots using a rifle on an incoming missile, but you're welcome to try. :) Just one more example of how robots are surpassing our abilities on the battlefield.

The anti aircraft mini-gun targets enemy drones, bombs and incoming missiles. Most effective in groups and spread along your perimeter and can be upgraded to include a heat seeking missile launcher... or two.  

Thank you for considering the game!

[previewyoutube=nx1ZoxXqi8U;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Release Date, Hacking Feature and Pricing
notes.notes:
[b]We're releasing March 13th![/b] 

Which means I have 6 weeks to continue polishing the game and I want your suggestions! As far as pricing goes,[b] I plan on pricing just under $20usd.[/b] [b]This is not a AAA title[/b] and the price should reflect that and set everyone's expectations realistically. I'm an Indie Dev trying to make enough of a living to continue making better and better games and I appreciate your support. It's been a real labor of love and implementing my vision has been one of the hardest projects I've ever done. I'm quite happy with the final result but I can keep improving the game with your help and feedback.

[b]Even after launch, I plan to continue improving the game and being there for the community.[/b]

This week I'll be sharing some more videos showing some of the challenging enemy tech you'll be facing. One of the coolest visuals in the game I think are the anti-aircraft mini guns winding up and trying to take out incoming surface to surface missiles. Just one AA gun has little chance, but 4 or 5 spread out around your miners can be extremely effective but not invincible.

We've received a lot of great ideas from the community and we want to implement as many as we can before launch. This one is the ability to be able to hack an enemy tank and have it attack it's own kind which then sparks a battle between themselves. 

This is actually quite a strong ability as it typically leads to the destruction of the hacked tank as well as dealing damage to the surrounding enemy tanks. Hacking is introduced early in Level 2 and can be used onwards. 

This was a great idea and a lot of fun programming into the game, another tool to use against the evil AI! 

[b]Please keep the suggestions coming![/b]

notes.title: Development Update - Upgradeable Sentry Classes
notes.notes:
[h3][b]First, thank you everyone for your encouragement and support![/b][/h3]
Thank you to all the beta testers who gave the game a try and shared their feedback with me!!!

Overwhelming feedback from Beta Testers is that they all want more options to fight against the robots. It took me a while to decide how to solve this and after a lot of work I have been able implement upgradeable Sentry classes.

There are 3 Sentry Classes that are upgradeable. Each Sentry type can now be Upgraded by 2 levels at a cost of 30 metal units each time.

[h3][b]Sniper Sentry[/b][/h3]
Range: 200 meters
Accuracy: 95 percent
Rate of Fire: 12 rounds per minute
Projectile: 50 caliber high explosive round at 800 meters per second
Targeting System: FLIR with predictive targeting that compensates aim for target movement during bullet flight time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/b4056e3b7bb40ca8081868d6247323002e59583b.jpg[/img]

Upgrade Level 1 - Upgrades to Armour Piercing Rounds
Upgrade Level 2 - Double Rate Of Fire

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/a14db592c204ba3976e3d4d943641390ad52479c.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Machine Gun Sentry[/b][/h3]
Range: 100 meters
Accuracy: 85 percent
Rate of Fire: 5 rounds per second in 5 round bursts
Projectile: incendiary armor piercing rounds
Targeting System: FLIR with predictive targeting that compensates aim for target movement during bullet flight time
Should be used tactically in close quarters terrain against ground targets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36021092/59cf12f1d17e0a7d479d2daa78e659469da98155.jpg[/img]

Being able to upgrade each Sentry class allows the player to choose between spending your valuable metal on either upgrading to more effective Sentrys or building more Sentrys. The choice is not so simple. Fewer but more powerful Sentrys means fewer targets for the attacking tanks to focus their firepower. Having more Sentrys spread out the incoming damage allowing more time for repairs. This adds another layer of strategy the Player can use to give themselves an advantage.

One of the hardest parts of making a video game is turning your unique idea into a really fun game to play. Even once the game is coded and stable and all your ideas are working... is the game fun to play? I feel that's where I'm at right now... coded and stable. Making the Sentrys upgradeable definitely makes the game more fun to play. I feel like I'm getting there, thanks to your feedback.

Another popular request is being able to hack the incoming tanks... hmmm... will update you again next week!
